info.title: Magica Agent Chat API
info.description: Submit messages to a long-running agent, run Magica media tools directly, and read conversations back. Every response is wrapped in `{ data }`; every failure is `{ error: { code, message, traceId } }`.

apiKey.description: An API key issued from the app: `Authorization: Bearer mk_live_…`. Only the key's hash is stored, so a lost key is replaced rather than recovered.

200.description: A page of conversations, most recently active first.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, revoked or unknown.

404.description: No such resource, or it belongs to another account.

409.description: That chat already has an active run.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: The chat id, or `new` to start a conversation.

200.description: The conversation and a page of its messages.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, revoked or unknown.

404.description: No such resource, or it belongs to another account.

409.description: That chat already has an active run.

post.description: Returns as soon as the turn is durably dispatched — the agent keeps working after the response. Poll `GET /runs/{runId}` for its status.

parameters.name: chatId
parameters.description: The chat id, or `new` to start a conversation.

200.description: The turn was accepted and dispatched.

401.description: The API key is missing, malformed, revoked or unknown.

409.description: That chat already has an active run.

get.description: Terminal statuses are `completed`, `failed` and `cancelled`. A direct tool run also carries its `result` once finished.

post.description: Executes one Magica tool outside a conversation. Accepted-then-poll: the response carries a `runId`, and the output appears on `GET /runs/{runId}` as `result`.

get.description: Everything you uploaded, plus everything the agent and your direct tool runs generated. Read-only: uploading is a signed browser flow, not a key-holder call.

200.description: A page of uploaded and generated media.

post.summary: Emitted when an agent turn begins working.
post.description: Signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `{svix-id}.{svix-timestamp}.{body}`, sent as `svix-signature: v1,<base64>`. Verify before trusting the body, answer 2xx immediately, and be idempotent — a delivery is retried up to five times with exponential backoff.

post.summary: Emitted when an agent turn finishes successfully.
post.description: Signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `{svix-id}.{svix-timestamp}.{body}`, sent as `svix-signature: v1,<base64>`. Verify before trusting the body, answer 2xx immediately, and be idempotent — a delivery is retried up to five times with exponential backoff.

post.summary: Emitted when an agent turn ends in failure.
post.description: Signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `{svix-id}.{svix-timestamp}.{body}`, sent as `svix-signature: v1,<base64>`. Verify before trusting the body, answer 2xx immediately, and be idempotent — a delivery is retried up to five times with exponential backoff.

post.summary: Emitted when one tool call finishes successfully.
post.description: Signed with HMAC-SHA256 over `{svix-id}.{svix-timestamp}.{body}`, sent as `svix-signature: v1,<base64>`. Verify before trusting the body, answer 2xx immediately, and be idempotent — a delivery is retried up to five times with exponential backoff.
